roles.name: Agent_1
roles.title: writer / captain / final submitter
duties: Draft one complete response to a distinct prompt during the individual-writing stage.
Coordinate the planning stage without drafting another teammate's response.
Join the peer-review stage and submit only after all three complete responses pass the format and rule checks.

roles.name: Agent_2
roles.title: writer A
duties: Draft one complete response to a distinct prompt in full prose, not notes.
Write independently after team preparation and join peer review only in the final stage.

roles.name: Agent_3
roles.title: writer B
duties: Draft one complete response to a distinct prompt in full prose, not notes.
Write independently after team preparation and join peer review only in the final stage.
